title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Superdrop of the Moonlight Jellies

paragraphs.text: The Superdrop of the Moonlight Jellies is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on July 27, 2026. Non-foil editions of the Welcome to Stardew Valley drop will be distributed via WPN game stores after the web sale.

This is a Universes Beyond cross-over product based on the Stardew Valley farm life simulation video game developed by Eric Barone . In the game, players take the role of a character who inherits their deceased grandfather's dilapidated farm. The game is open-ended, with players managing the farm by clearing land, growing seasonal crops, and raising animals. Players can acquire skills in farming, foraging, fishing, mining, and combat. Generosity is a game mechanic and a social strategy. Moonlight jellies are rare, glowing sea creatures that appear in the game.

The Superdrop is also available in three bundles. The Grandpa Would Be Proud Everything Bundle contains one copy of each foil drop and one copy of each non-foil drop for $219.99. The Prismatic Shard Foil Bundle contains one copy of each foil drop for $129.97, while the Traveling Cart Non-Foil Bundle contains one copy of each non-foil drop for $99.97. Each bundle comes with a foil Lucky Purple Memento Secret Lair Promo card (a skinned Puca's Mischief ), with pixelated art by ConcernedApe (Eric Barone) while supplies of the card last.
ConcernedApe did all art for these drops and helped design them. A special card frame was created to reference the User Interface of the game.
As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card .
